# #311 — Contract-parity harness: shared runtime-neutral fixtures + CI gate + pre-push hook for the TS/Python client pair

State: CLOSED
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none
Created: 2026-07-21T05:26:17Z
Updated: 2026-07-21T18:42:39Z
Closed: 2026-07-21T18:42:39Z

---

Phase 1 of the matched-clients plan (TS client to be built as the peer of python/openbrain-memory; agreed 2026-07-21).

Drift reality check: the clients are already asymmetric in both directions within one week of shipping (#307 drain is Python-only, #308 error_category is TS-adapter-only). Parity by discipline is not a plan; parity must be a build failure.

Deliverables:
1. Extract the memory contract scenarios into a runtime-neutral fixture set (`contracts/memory/`): request/response/receipt scenarios covering session lifecycle, exact-scope proof (#294), spool + backpressure semantics (#300), redact-before-persist (#304), drain (#307), receipt shapes + error categories (#308), contract id/schema-hash declaration (currently 2026-07-17.memory-tools.v22).
2. Make the existing pytest suite consume those fixtures (no behavior change; pure extraction proves the fixtures are faithful).
3. Parity manifest: machine-checkable capability map (implemented-in-python / implemented-in-ts / declared runtime-specific with reason). CI validates manifest against both suites once the TS client lands; until then TS entries are 'pending' and the gate enforces Python-side conformance only.
4. `contract-parity` CI job on the existing runners: fails any PR touching client source without fixture/manifest coherence.
5. Repo-local pre-push hook (bun, wired via core.hooksPath, no /bin/bash): runs the parity suite when client paths are touched.
6. PR-body validator line: `Contract parity: [x] fixtures updated` or `[x] runtime-specific because: <reason>` — required for client-touching PRs.
7. Server-side tripwire: log per-request client contract id/schema hash mismatches so escaped drift is visible in live telemetry.

Follow-ups tracked separately: TS client implementation against these fixtures; Development-side Claude adapter cutover.
